CustomField.description: Upper bound on tool-calling iterations per AI message, applied to every AI Agent's Max Tool Calling Iterations. Every iteration makes at least one callout and Salesforce allows 100 per transaction. Blank or below 1 falls back to the code default (20).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Hard ceiling on any AI Agent's Max Tool Calling Iterations. Keep well under 100 (the per-transaction callout limit).
CustomField.label: Max Tool Calling Iterations Cap
